title: Local subtractions and renormalization-group monotonicity: exact defect and sphere flows
summary: We ask when the sphere free energy of a quantum field theory, after subtraction of its local counterterms in a fixed renormalization prescription, decreases monotonically along the renormalization-group (RG) flow. The counterterms fix the required zeros of the subtraction polynomial, but positivity of the spectral data alone does not determine monotonicity. For Gaussian determinants, complete monotonicity of a rescaled integrated heat trace is sufficient. This condition proves monotonicity for Robin boundary flows on every sphere $S^p$, $p\ge2$.
